about_the_game: GORE is a found footage horror experience that immerses players in a mountain range designed to resemble the scenery of the Pacific Northwest of the United States. Drawing inspiration from the likes of Lovecraft, 2001: A Space Odyssey, and John Carpenter’s The Thing, this game pulls you deep into a decaying wilderness where something incomprehensible is rapidly spreading through the surrounding environment. You must discover where this fleshy entity came from, armed with only a flashlight and handheld camera.

content_descriptors.notes: There will be occasional animal screams of pain (unseen) and occasional piles of blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 570 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirextX-Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5-10400
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 7600 / NVIDIA RTX 2060 or better

short_description: GORE is a found footage horror experience set deep in the mountains of the Pacific Northwest with Lovecraftian inspiration. Explore the wilderness and uncover the origins of the fleshy entity.
